AlternateTargets: after a long pause, he said
Senses.Explanation: A narrative turn marker used by case recorders: after an interval, the record says that someone spoke. It packages an elapsed pause together with the resumption-of-speech verb. The named master supplies the words that follow the marker, but the marker itself belongs to the recorder’s narration.
Senses.Note: The frozen corpus has 2,184 exact hits in 98 files representing 95 works. Eight anchors cover hall addresses, replies after questions, a response after group silence, and transmitted early cases across six independent works. Repeated witnesses from one work do not inflate work spread.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂良久曰。夫行脚禪流直須著忖。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄), Shexian Guisheng section: recorder narration marks an interval before Shexian resumes a hall address with an instruction to travelling Chan people.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 上堂良久曰 places the pause-and-said formula in recorder narration after the hall-address heading; Shexian's direct speech starts with 夫行脚禪流.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久曰。春雨一滴滑如油。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄), Guyin Yuncong section: recorder narration marks an interval before Guyin says, 'A drop of spring rain is slick as oil.'

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 良久曰 links the narrated interval to the following quotation 春雨一滴滑如油; the formula itself is outside Guyin's quoted words.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久曰。美食不中飽人喫。便下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄), Jiufeng Qin section: recorder narration marks an interval before Jiufeng says, 'Fine food does not suit a person already full,' and leaves the seat.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The sequence 上堂曰…良久曰…便下座 narrates Jiufeng's pause and stage movement around the words 美食不中飽人喫.

Occurrences.Kwic: 且作麼生即是？良久曰：還會麼？珍重！
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Collection of the Five Lamps (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), Tianyi Yihuai section: recorder narration marks an interval before Tianyi says, 'Do you understand? Take care.'

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The case voice asks 且作麼生即是, then 良久曰 narrates Tianyi's pause; his quoted continuation begins 還會麼.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，良久曰：大眾看看。便下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Strict Lineage of the Five Lamps (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)), Wuyun Zhifeng section: recorder narration marks an interval before Wuyun tells the assembly to look and then leaves the seat.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 上堂，良久曰：大眾看看。便下座 is a hall-event record: the compiler supplies the temporal marker and stage direction, while Wuyun supplies 大眾看看.

Occurrences.Kwic: 且道彌勒在甚麼處？良久曰：夜行莫踏白，不是水便是石。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Orthodox Continuation of the Lamp (續燈正統), Xuansha Sengzhao section: recorder narration marks an interval before Sengzhao answers where Maitreya is with 'When walking at night, do not step on white.'

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 且道彌勒在甚麼處 is followed by 良久曰; the narrator records Sengzhao's pause and his direct answer begins 夜行莫踏白.

Occurrences.Kwic: 眾無語。師良久曰：「金輪懶向當堂坐，何用丹墀擊靜鞭？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Zhean Fan (蔗菴範禪師語錄): after the assembly gives no answer, recorder narration marks an interval before Zhean Fan's two-line response.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 眾無語。師良久曰 explicitly assigns the silence and elapsed interval to the record voice; Zhean's quoted verse starts 金輪懶向當堂坐.

Occurrences.Kwic: 可良久曰。覔心了不可得。祖曰。我與汝安心竟。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Dazu Huike case: recorder narration marks Huike's interval before he answers Bodhidharma that the mind cannot be found.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 可良久曰 contains Huike's name as the subject of the narrated pause-and-said construction; Huike's direct words begin 覔心了不可得.
